description: An acknowledgement whose Ack Data is longer than 21 bytes goes in the long ACK-ONLY form, the Ack Data after the header CRC with its own CRC-32.
note: Conn 1 binds SAP 9 for ARQ. Link setup as cas/make-called-accept and dts-arq/rx-data-acked: at 2000 the peer 0.0.1.3 calls with an Ed4 PHYSICAL LINK REQUEST, recorded Ed4 (B-0408), our accept goes out at 52000 (25 bytes, a whole block, so no fill), and when that transmission ends at 57550 the link is made with the 16-bit family, RX LWE 0 (C-0782). At 61000 one burst from the peer, every D_PDU with EOT 20 (end by 71000): FSNs 1, 3, 5 and every odd FSN to 175, so the window from FSN 1 to RX UWE 175 alternates received and missing. FSN 1 is a whole C_PDU 'ping' without DELIVER IN ORDER, so it is delivered at once (C-0179): cas.first_data stops (B-0215) and the SIS hands it to conn 1. Every other D_PDU is a one-byte middle segment (neither C_PDU START nor END), stored and not delivered. FSN 0 never arrives, so RX LWE stays 0 (C-0776) and an acknowledgement is owed (C-0174). The burst ends at 62000: csma.vdcd_end to 71000, LBT rule 1 (K-0067), contention 12000 ms. At 83000 the acknowledgement goes: the run length encoding of those 175 alternating bits needs one code per bit, 175 bytes, and the bitmap 22 bytes (55 hex each, C-0207, C-0208, C-0210, C-0227), so the bitmap goes (C-0225, C-1150). That is more than 21 bytes, so the long form is used (C-0219, C-0235): RX LWE 0, Encoding 0, Offset 0 and Ack Length 22 in a 10-byte header (h = 10) with no Ack Data in it, then the header CRC, then the 22 bytes of Ack Data (C-0220) and a CRC-32 on them, CRC-32-S5066 of C.4.2.11 sent as for any segment (C-0234): 41 bytes, EOT 20. Fill (C-1154): 9 bytes are left in the second block, too few for a copy of the 41-byte ACK-ONLY or a PADDING D_PDU, so they are zero filled. The transmission is 41 bytes, 2 blocks, and ends at 93350; no data of ours, so no dts.ack_wait. Fixture: preamble 600, flush 150, 25 bytes and 4800 ms a block, so an n-block transmission lasts 750 + 4800 n ms, and the EOT of a D_PDU starting in block b of n is ceil((4800 (n - b) + 150) / 500) (C-0104, C-1043). Addresses 0.0.1.2 (this node) and 0.0.1.3 take address size 3 (C-0133), so a DATA-ONLY is 19 bytes plus its segment, an ACK-ONLY 15 bytes plus its Ack Data in the header form and 19 bytes plus its Ack Data and CRC-32 in the long form, a PADDING D_PDU 11 bytes. Seed 0 draws uniform(16) = 15, 4, 15, 12: contention waits 45000, 12000, 45000, 36000 ms (K-0080).  The SIS soft link times are unset, so they are derived: sis.soft_link_idle and sis.soft_link_min_hold (called node only) three answer waits, sis.soft_link_max six; none falls due within the run, and the idle wait stops while an ARQ U_PDU is outstanding (A-0320, A-0321, A-0326). Since corpus 0.28.0 (P7-3), every D_PDU this node sends to a peer recorded Ed4 carries EOW 0xF01, CAPABILITY (Ed4 1, Duplex 0), where it carried EMPTY (C-0426, C-1260); an owed UNRECOGNIZED-TYPE-ERROR still goes first (C-1079), and D_PDUs to a peer of unknown edition, a peer recorded Ed3 or a group carry EMPTY as before. Where this note says EOW 0 or EMPTY for such a D_PDU, read CAPABILITY. Only EOW and header CRC bytes changed.
